# PASR — Provenance-Aware Span Recall

> A zero-setup context-broker MCP server for coding and document agents. Given a query
> and a workspace, it returns a small, hard-budgeted, fully-traceable slice: every span
> carries its `file:line`, token count, retrieval score, and the reason it was kept. It
> classifies each query (localized / trace / aggregation) and tells the agent when it
> is the wrong tool. Deterministic (byte-identical output for the same input), offline
> by default — no daemon, no vector database, no index to build.

Install: `pip install pasr-mcp` (PyPI: pasr-mcp) or `uvx pasr-mcp --workspace .`.
MCP config: `{"command":"uvx","args":["pasr-mcp","--workspace","."]}`.

## MCP tools

- select_context(query, include=[...], budget_tokens=3000, map_tokens=0, trace=""): a
  budgeted, provenance-tracked slice for a query. `map_tokens` prepends a query-ranked
  symbol-index header carved out of the budget; `trace` folds a symbol's dependency
  closure into the same slice.
- trace_dependencies(symbol, include=[...], max_depth=4, direction="dependencies"):
  deterministic def/reference closure for a symbol (Python, JS/TS). direction="callers"
  reverses it for impact analysis.
- explain_selection(selection_id): return the stored receipt for a prior selection.
- expand_context(selection_id, budget_tokens): re-run a prior selection once, larger.

## CLI

- pasr explain "<query>" [paths]: run a selection, print the receipt.
- pasr trace <symbol> [paths] [--callers]: a dependency closure.
- pasr pack <name> "<query>" [paths]: save a committable Context Pack.
- pasr review [--staged|--range|--diff]: diff-aware context — touched defs + affected callers.
- pasr context --issue <text> [paths]: headless slice for CI / agents.
- pasr report [--price-per-mtok N]: summarise the usage ledger.
